production.speakerStemPolicy: one dry mono WAV stem per actor + separately recorded SFX/music stems

production.intelligibility: mix spoken words above music; proof numbers, negative particles, hedges and speaker identities in the final mix
production.playback: recheck native audio playback in mobile Safari with headphones and speakers
production.languagePolicy: review every unconfirmed line language; do not assume English/Spanish from speaker ethnicity
production.soundPolicy: silence may carry emotion; preserve consonants and headroom; sound cues never obscure an error anchor
production.licensing: collect actor/voice/talent releases, music/sample license, cover and performance rights before deployment
production.asr: export 16/24 kHz mono PCM16 for Meta Voice Transcribe; ASR only advises, never certifies bilingual fidelity
